```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(car)
library(tidyr)

# Load the dataset and remove rows with missing values
df_full <- penguins %>% drop_na()


## peek at total number of adorable penguins
table(df_full$species)
```


## Slide Demo

## 1) Calculate Mean
```{r}
## Randomly sample  68 penguins from each species (there are only 68 chinstraps)
set.seed(123) # random seed
df_sampled <- df_full %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  sample_n(68) %>%
  ungroup()

# Q-Q plots for each species
ggplot(penguins, aes(sample = flipper_length_mm)) +
  geom_qq() +
  geom_qq_line(color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~ species) +
  labs(
    title = "Normal Q-Q Plots of Flipper Length by Species",
    x = "Theoretical Quantiles",
    y = "Sample Quantiles (Flipper Length, mm)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

## Preform Levene test
leveneTest(flipper_length_mm ~ species, data = df_sampled)

## Determine mean flipper length for each species
df_sampled %>%
  group_by(species) %>%
  summarise(mean_flipper_length = mean(flipper_length_mm))


## Determine mean flipper length for all sampled penguins
df_sampled %>%
  summarise(mean_flipper_length = mean(flipper_length_mm))
            
```



## 2) Calculate  Sum of Squares Between Groups
```{r}
# Calculate the grand mean penguins
grand_mean <- mean(df_sampled$flipper_length_mm)

# Calculate the between-group sum of squares
ss_between <- df_sampled %>%
  group_by(species) %>% 
  summarise(
    n = n(), 
    mean_flipper_length = mean(flipper_length_mm)
  ) %>%  # Calculate sample size and mean flipper length for each species
  mutate(
    ss = n * (mean_flipper_length - grand_mean)^2
  ) %>%  # Calculate each species' contribution to SSB
  summarise(
    ss_between = sum(ss)
  )      # Sum contributions across all species

# Display the between-group sum of squares
ss_between

```


## 3) Calculate Sum of Squares Within Groups
```{r}

# Calculate the within-group sum of squares
ss_within <- df_sampled %>%
  group_by(species) %>% 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_flipper_length = mean(flipper_length_mm)
  ) %>%  # Calculate sample size and mean flipper length for each species
  left_join(df_sampled, by = "species") %>%  # Add individual penguin observations to their species means
  mutate(
    ss = (flipper_length_mm - mean_flipper_length)^2
  ) %>%  # Calculate squared deviations from each species' mean
  group_by(species) %>% 
  summarise(
    ss_within = sum(ss)
  )      # Sum squared deviations within each species

# Display the within-group sum of squares for each species
ss_within


## Calculate the total within group sum of squares
ss_within_total <- sum(ss_within$ss_within)

# Display the total within group sum of squares
ss_within_total
```


## 4) Variance  (Mean Squares)
```{r}
ms_between <- ss_between$ss_between / (length(unique(df_sampled$species)) - 1) ## 27,708.62/2
ms_within <- ss_within_total / (nrow(df_sampled) - length(unique(df_sampled$species)))## 9,253.631/201
ms_between
ms_within
```

## 5) Calculate F-statistic
```{r}
f_statistic <- ms_between / ms_within
f_statistic
```

## 6) Calculate F-statistic for ANOVA
```{r}
anova_result <- aov(flipper_length_mm ~ species, data = df_sampled)
tab <- summary(anova_result)[[1]]

df1   <- tab[["Df"]][1]          # 2
df2   <- tab[["Df"]][2]          # 201
f_val <- tab[["F value"]][1]     # 300.933
p_val <- tab[["Pr(>F)"]][1]      # P-value from other variables and ANOVA table

alpha <- 0.05 

# Formatted string for p-value presentation
p_str <- ifelse(p_val < 2.2e-16, "< 2.2e-16", sprintf("= %.3g", p_val))

# Print 
sprintf("F(%d, %d) = %.1f, p %s", df1, df2, f_val, p_str)

# hypothesis check
if (p_val < alpha) {
  cat("There is a statistically significant difference in mean flipper length across species.\n")
} else {
  cat("There is no statistically significant difference in mean flipper length across species.\n")
}
```
## Generate Visual
```{r}
ggplot(df_sampled, aes(x = species, y = flipper_length_mm, fill = species)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "ANOVA Visual: Flipper Length by Species",
       x = "Species",
       y = "Flipper Length (mm)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") 
```



## 7) Post-hoc Analysis
```{r}
TukeyHSD(aov(flipper_length_mm ~ species, data = df_sampled))
```
